subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint — security evidence sprint / deconflict
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Alice Hayes <alice.hayes@fastpay.com>, security@fastpay.com
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-19T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint — security evidence sprint / deconflict

Hi Alice / FastPay security team —

Thanks again for the sync today. As promised, I’m summarizing the action items from our MAP-focused checkpoint and surfacing a couple of deconflict points before the evidence sprint kicks off Monday. I attached the latest MAP_tracker_v3.xlsx (tabbed by owner + evidence type).

Quick summary / asks:
- Audit logs: FastPay asked for a short sample export (last 7 days) and a brief explanation of retention windows. FastPay -> requested by 2027-07-21 EOD.
- Pen test: FastPay prefers an initial whitebox scope for auth/session flows; Redwood proposed a 2-week window. Need to confirm exact hostnames and scheduling blackout windows.
- DPA clauses: Paul from legal asked for the signed DPA scanned copy; Redwood legal will provide countersigned version by 2027-07-22.

Owners I assigned in the tracker (checkpoint):
- Audit log sample: Rishi M. (Rishi, please push sample to Drive and send stub + readme) — due 2027-07-21
- Pen test scope doc: Vanessa O. (Vanessa, please coordinate with vendor and FastPay sec) — draft due 2027-07-20
- DPA countersign: Neha K. (Neha, I flagged for legal) — due 2027-07-22
- Evidence intake / mapping into MAP: Karthik I. (Karthik, create map of artifacts -> SOC 2 / DPA rows) — due 2027-07-21

Next checkpoint: Friday 2027-07-23 10:00 AM PT (30 min) — goal: verify artifacts, confirm pen-test window, and close any open gating items.

Attachments: MAP_tracker_v3.xlsx (tracker), referenced Drive folder link below.

Thanks —
Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Manager, Customer Security
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

From: Alice Hayes <alice.hayes@fastpay.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: security@fastpay.com, Paul Ng <paul.ng@corp-legal.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-20T11:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint — security evidence sprint / deconflict

Thanks, Irene — this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Audit logs: we only need an anonymized sample showing user-auth events, token refresh events, and an example of a deleted-object audit log. Can you confirm the sample will not contain PII? If it does, please pseudo-anonymize before sharing. We’d like the sample by 2027-07-21 morning if possible.

2) Pen test scope: our security team prefers to provide a short list of test accounts and blackout times. We need Redwood’s proposed hostnames / IPs and recommended windows by 2027-07-20 so we can align vendor availability.

3) DPA: Paul from legal has confirmed we’ll need the countersigned copy before procurement completes — timeline looks tight but doable.

Also, please include a brief readme with the audit log sample describing the export tool and timezone used.

On Tue, Jul 20, 2027 at 11:34 AM, Alice Hayes <alice.hayes@fastpay.com> wrote:
> Quick note: we will not accept raw customer emails in the sample.

Best,
Alice Hayes
Head of Security Programs, FastPay
alice.hayes@fastpay.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Alice Hayes <alice.hayes@fastpay.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-20T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint — audit log sample and retention note

Following up with the audit log sample (stub + readme attached). I exported a 7-day slice scoped to the auth subsystem; all PII fields were redacted and replaced with deterministic hashes per our standard anonymization flow. See attachment: audit-log-sample-2027-07-20.json (10KB stub) and README_audit_export.txt in the Drive folder.

Retention: Redwood keeps raw audit events for 90 days hot, then 365 days in cold storage (encrypted). We documented TTLs and retention policy in the README.

Action items updated in the tracker:
- I uploaded the sample to the shared Drive and pasted the link into cell B4 of MAP_tracker_v3.xlsx.
- Vanessa: tagging you for pen-test hostnames; I captured the initial candidate list under the pen-test tab.

Irene: please confirm the sample landed OK on your side and whether FastPay needs a different anonymization approach.

Thanks,
Rishi
Principal Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: audit-log-sample-2027-07-20.json (redacted stub)
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Alice Hayes <alice.hayes@fastpay.com>, security@fastpay.com
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-22T15:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint — security evidence sprint / deconflict (summary + next steps)

Alice / team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming outcomes from this mini-sprint: 
- Audit log sample: delivered and accepted in principle. FastPay requested one small field rename (event_ts -> event_timestamp) — Rishi will push an updated stub by 2027-07-23 9:00 AM PT. (owner: rishi_malhotra)
- Pen test: Vanessa will send the pen-test scope + proposed windows (including blackout times) by 2027-07-23 EOD. FastPay to confirm vendor availability and provide test accounts. (owner: vanessa_ortiz)
- DPA countersign: Neha is coordinating with Redwood Legal; target 2027-07-22 EOD for countersigned PDF. (owner: neha_kapoor)
- MAP artifact mapping: Karthik will finalize SOC 2 row mappings and flag any gaps by 2027-07-23. (owner: karthik_iyer)

I updated MAP_tracker_v3.xlsx to reflect the amended field name request and added a pen-test tab with Vanessa’s placeholders. Please review the Drive folder before our Friday checkpoint (link below). If FastPay legal needs an earlier review of the countersigned DPA, Paul — let us know and we can escalate.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1MAP-Sprint-FastPay
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/fastpay/record/FP-2027-0911

Next checkpoint: Friday 2027-07-23 10:00 AM PT (calendar invite updated).

Thanks again — close looks achievable if we hit the individual owner dates above.

Irene
Senior Manager, Customer Security
Redwood Inference
